specification.problem: Implement CCZ/Toffoli on 3 qubits with three global all-to-all Ising two-qubit gates G(theta)=exp(-i theta/2 sum_{i<j} Z_i Z_j) interleaved with single-qubit rotations, no ancillas. Fredkin and CCCZ (4 and 7 global gates) are outside the exact scope.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest useful instance: 3-qubit CCZ (Toffoli = H_t CCZ H_t) built from three global ZZ/XX gates and single-qubit rotation layers. The exact angle schedule is not given in the abstract and must be found by solving phase equations or by numerical optimisation. Fredkin (4 global gates), CCCZ (7 global gates) and the 5-gate nearest-neighbour variants are not specified here.

symbols.domain: integer, 3 for CCZ and Toffoli, 4 for CCCZ

symbols.meaning: Hamming weight of basis state x
angle of the k-th global gate
single-qubit layer product between global gates, e.g. Rx/Ry/Rz or Hadamard
third elementary symmetric polynomial of the bits, equal to x1 x2 x3 for n=3

equations.label: Global gate depends on Hamming weight
equations.description: The pair sum of Z_iZ_j equals ((sum Z_i)^2 - n)/2, and sum Z_i has eigenvalue n-2w. So the global ZZ gate is diagonal with a phase quadratic in w.
equations.justification: Algebraic identity: sum_{i<j} Z_iZ_j = ((sum Z_i)^2 - n)/2.
assumptions: Global gate is symmetric all-to-all ZZ with a tunable angle

equations.label: CCZ target
equations.description: Target diagonal gate, a phase of pi on |111> only.
equations.justification: The abstract names the control-control-phase gate; the formula is the standard definition.

equations.label: Toffoli from CCZ
equations.description: Hadamard conjugation of the target qubit.

equations.label: Three-global-gate ansatz
equations.description: Circuit ansatz with three global gates and interleaved single-qubit layers. The angles and the layers U_k are free parameters to be solved for.
equations.abstract_quote: using three and four global two-qubit gates, respectively
equations.justification: The abstract gives the count of 3 global gates; the interleaved structure is the sketch's assumption and the parameters are unknown.
assumptions: Free individually addressable single-qubit rotations between global gates
Angles found numerically or from phase equations at multiples of pi/4

equations.label: Fredkin decomposition
equations.description: Standard reduction of Fredkin to Toffoli. The 4-global-gate version absorbs the CNOTs into basis changes (not specified here).
equations.justification: Standard identity; the abstract only states the count of four global gates.

registers.name: q
registers.size: 3 (c1,c2,t) for CCZ/Toffoli; 3 (c,a,b) for Fredkin; 4 for CCCZ

specification.initial_state: Each computational basis state |x> for truth-table checks, or the unitary is read from the simulator with no measurement.

steps.description: Build G(theta) in Qiskit as RZZ(theta) on every pair of qubits (or CX-RZ-CX, with H conjugation for the XX version).
Solve for or numerically optimise the angles theta_1..theta_3 and the single-qubit layers U_0..U_2 so that V equals CCZ up to global phase.
For Toffoli, add H on the target before and after the CCZ circuit.
Optionally, for Fredkin, wrap the Toffoli with CNOTs as the baseline (more gates than the paper's 4-global-gate version).

specification.measurement: No measurements for a unitary check (compare to the target up to global phase). For a counts check, measure all qubits after preparing each basis input, remembering Qiskit little-endian ordering.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Compute the overlap |Tr(U_target^dagger V)|/2^n, which should equal 1. Alternatively compare the truth table.
assumptions: Global gate is all-to-all ZZ with tunable angle, built from RZZ on every pair
Free single-qubit rotations between global gates
Exact synthesis, correct up to global phase
Qubit 0 is the least significant bit
missing_information: Explicit angles and single-qubit rotation layers for the 3 and 4 global gate circuits
Whether the paper uses ZZ or XX with specific basis changes
